scope: 30 additional contextual body figures across eight pages; General Conference opening image excluded from qualifying body count. Existing text/cards preserved.

placements.title: Begin with the purpose of worship
placements.description: Two friends read scripture together on a shaded garden terrace. Their quiet study turns toward the Kirtland dedicatory prayer and its longing for learning, holiness and God's help.
placements.alt: Two friends reading an open scripture book on a shaded garden terrace
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Carry a covenant into daily care
placements.description: Two neighbors clear fallen branches from an older neighbor's path. The work is practical and personal, quietly fulfilling the baptismal promise to help carry another's burden.

placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Temple building across generations

placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved Christ-praying artwork; full official Prayers for Peace message read 2026-09-08, including consistent prayer in joyful and distressed times. Caption application is explicitly personal.
placements.sourceRead: Official full message paragraphs corresponding to lines82–98 support sincere prayer without flowery wording and continued prayer rather than only in crisis. No direct quotation.
